item.title: Claude Code: from PRD to pull request with agents
item.description:
Introduction

I discovered Claude Code a few months ago when our team was struggling to keep code reviews consistent. After six weeks with the tool, we cut average PR time from 4 days to 1 day — and that was only the start.

Claude Code automates a large part of the development workflow. PRDs, TDD, code review, even MCP setup. It is not magic, but it works well enough to change the day-to-day.

item.title: CI/CD upstream vs downstream: when to use each
item.description:
Integrating Skupper upstream and downstream

Integrating upstream and downstream projects is rarely simple. Here is a practical approach for Skupper on the upstream side and its commercial downstream line, using familiar tools for each side of the work.

Introduction

Skupper is an open-source project that provides a service network for Kubernetes. It is developed by Red Hat and released under the Apache 2.0 license. That is the upstream version—the one under active development.
